name: knoeledge_router
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Goal**: Refactor knowledge-related API endpoints out of the monolithic `app.py` into a dedicated router module.
2. **New file created**: `codx/junior/api/knowledge.py` — a FastAPI `APIRouter` with prefix `/knowledge` containing all knowledge endpoints.
3. **Endpoints migrated**: `reload`, `reload-path`, `delete` (POST & DELETE), `reload-search`, `status`, `keywords` (GET & POST), plus a **new** `metrics` endpoint.
4. **`app.py` updated**: Removed all inline `/api/knowledge/*` handlers and registered the new router via `app.include_router(knowledge_router, prefix="/api")`.
5. **No breaking changes**: All URL paths remain identical (`/api/knowledge/...`), so no client-side updates are required.

messages.content: create a knowledge router and move all knowledge related routes to the new module.
